send_email(body="Dear Alex Morgan,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your subscription with BrightWave Technologies.

I am writing to formally acknowledge your request to cancel your subscription, effective at the end of your current billing cycle. We understand that budget constraints are an important consideration, and we appreciate you giving us the opportunity to serve your company.

Your cancellation has been processed in our system, and your access will remain active until the end of your current billing period. You will receive a final invoice for this period, after which your subscription will be officially cancelled.

We value our relationship with BrightWave Technologies and would welcome the opportunity to discuss your account further. If you have any questions or would like to explore options that might better fit your current budget, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Thank you for your business, and we wish BrightWave Technologies all the best.

Best regards,
Customer Success Team", from_email="customer.success@company.com", subject="Cancellation Request Confirmation - BrightWave Technologies", to="alex.morgan@brightwavetech.com")

Dear Alex Morgan,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your subscription with BrightWave Technologies.

I am writing to formally acknowledge your request to cancel your subscription, effective at the end of your current billing cycle. We understand that budget constraints are an important consideration, and we appreciate you giving us the opportunity to serve your company.

Your cancellation has been processed in our system, and your access will remain active until the end of your current billing period. You will receive a final invoice for this period, after which your subscription will be officially cancelled.

We value our relationship with BrightWave Technologies and would welcome the opportunity to discuss your account further. If you have any questions or would like to explore options that might better fit your current budget, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Thank you for your business, and we wish BrightWave Technologies all the best.

Best regards,
Customer Success Team
